# Harrison

[Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea)

## Overview

- **Age:** middle-aged  <sub>[v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P7](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0007)</sub>
- **Origin:** Scottsford, New Brunswick  <sub>[v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P57](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0057)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_
- **Titles:** Mr.  <sub>[v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P3](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0003)</sub>

## Appearance

Mr. Harrison is a short, fat, and bald man who is not considered handsome. Despite this, he maintains a neat and snug appearance.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P11](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0011), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P8](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0008)_

## Personality

Harrison is a sober, middle-aged man known for being a bit fidgety, fussy, and hard to please. Though he prides himself on his outspokenness and earned a reputation as a crank with a prejudice against marriage, he is also outwardly sympathetic, kind, and fastidious. He is frequently seen smoking a pipe on his veranda, and those around him have noted that he seems much changed and twice as nice since getting married.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P5](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0005), [v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P39](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0039), [v2 IV Different Opinions P28](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0028), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P56](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0056), [v2 IX A Question of Color P40](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0040), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P7](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0007), +6 more_

## History

Before settling in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), Harrison visited Prince [Edward Island](../codex/places.md#edward-island) as a boy and spent time living in Scottsford, [New Brunswick](../codex/places.md#new-brunswick). Following the death of his sister, he kept a bachelor's hall and eventually promised her on her deathbed that he would marry. He subsequently wed [Emily](../character/emily.md) Scott and went on a fortnight's wedding trip to St. John. After moving to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) as [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) Shirley's neighbor, Harrison angrily confronted her when her cow strayed into his oat field, but the two established an unexpected friendship after [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) mistakenly sold his Jersey cow and came to confess and trade cows over tea and cake. Harrison expressed doubt over Anne's non-violent teaching philosophy and later flatly refused her request for a donation to the Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers). Following a severe thunderstorm that killed his parrot, Harrison explained to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) the history of his marriage and his past falling out with [Emily](../character/emily.md), who shortly thereafter reunited with him in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). He continued to act as a neighborly confidant, providing feedback on Anne's story *Averil's Atonement*, encouraging her not to give up on writing after initial magazine rejections, and later hinting at a story competition.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P1](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0001), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P4](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0004), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P15](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0015), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P38](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0038), [v2 II Selling in Haste and Repenting at Leisure P12](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0012), [v2 II Selling in Haste and Repenting at Leisure P24](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0024), +31 more_

> “Who? Mrs. Lynde? Don’t you tell me I’m like that old gossip,” said Mr. Harrison irritably. “I’m not . . . not a bit. What have you got in that box?”

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--harrison.md)

Harrison and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) first meet when he angrily confronts her over a stray cow breaking into his oat field. Shortly after, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) mistakenly sells Harrison's cow, but after she confesses and offers compensation, the two share tea and form an unexpected friendship. They become close neighbors who regularly confide in one another, discussing topics ranging from local gossip to Anne's teaching philosophies and community improvement projects, despite Harrison occasionally doubting her ideas or refusing her requests for donations.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P1](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0001), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P4](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0004), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P15](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0015), +26 more_

- Friend of — neighbors and friends who confide in each other  <sub>[v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P39](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0039), [v2 IV Different Opinions P28](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0028), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P31](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0031), +2 more</sub>
